## Gaming

### Steam {#steam}

Steam with Proton included

- **Handleiding:** [Gaming & Media]({{< relref "/docs/applications/gaming-media" >}})
- **Bron:** [de regel](https://github.com/THectic-NL/Zephyrus-Linux/blob/main/src/static/scripts/quicksetup.py#L3520-L3521)

**Aanzetten**

```bash
# --- As root, one password prompt for all of it ---

# Install packages from the repositories
pacman -S --needed --noconfirm --noprogressbar steam
```

**Uitzetten (het terugdraaien)**

```bash
# --- As root, one password prompt for all of it ---

# Remove packages, one at a time (one that something else still needs is kept)
pacman -Rs --noconfirm --noprogressbar steam
```

### gamescope, MangoHud and GameMode {#gaming-tools}

The launch options the Proton guide uses

- **Handleiding:** [Proton & de Steam Linux Runtime]({{< relref "/docs/gaming/proton-slr" >}})
- **Bron:** [de regel](https://github.com/THectic-NL/Zephyrus-Linux/blob/main/src/static/scripts/quicksetup.py#L3522-L3524)

**Aanzetten**

```bash
# --- As root, one password prompt for all of it ---

# Install packages from the repositories
pacman -S --needed --noconfirm --noprogressbar gamescope mangohud gamemode lib32-gamemode
```

**Uitzetten (het terugdraaien)**

```bash
# --- As root, one password prompt for all of it ---

# Remove packages, one at a time (one that something else still needs is kept)
pacman -Rs --noconfirm --noprogressbar gamescope
pacman -Rs --noconfirm --noprogressbar mangohud
pacman -Rs --noconfirm --noprogressbar gamemode
pacman -Rs --noconfirm --noprogressbar lib32-gamemode
```

### ProtonUp-Qt {#protonup-qt}

Installs Proton-GE for games Valve's builds struggle with

- **Handleiding:** [Proton & de Steam Linux Runtime]({{< relref "/docs/gaming/proton-slr" >}})
- **Bron:** [de regel](https://github.com/THectic-NL/Zephyrus-Linux/blob/main/src/static/scripts/quicksetup.py#L3525-L3527)

**Aanzetten**

```bash
# --- As you, from Flathub ---

# Install from Flathub
flatpak install -y flathub net.davidotek.pupgui2
```

**Uitzetten (het terugdraaien)**

```bash
# --- As you, from Flathub ---

# Remove Flatpaks
flatpak uninstall -y net.davidotek.pupgui2
```
